steps.summary: supabase/migrations/20261006081704_schema.sql: 테이블 8개·상태 제약·인덱스·RLS(자기 행 SELECT, words 전체)·권한(anon 없음, authenticated SELECT만, 테이블·함수 기본 권한 포함), helper kst_today()·check_readiness(p_user_id, p_requirement 'consent'|'ready', p_language default null)→null|코드·record_activity(p_user_id)(profiles 직접 잠금), 계정 RPC ensure_profile(p_user_id)·agree_terms(p_user_id)·set_first_level(p_user_id, p_language, p_level int)·switch_language(p_user_id, p_language)·lower_level(p_user_id, p_language, p_level int)→level·start_trial(p_user_id)→pro_until (모두 INVOKER, search_path '', service_role만 EXECUTE, jsonb {ok,...}/{ok:false,code}). src/server/db: types.ts(DbErrorCode, DbResult), rpc.ts(callRpc(fn, args) → DbResult<RpcValue>(snake_case 값), SQL 오류·알 수 없는 code는 throw; toDbResult(fn, data)), account.ts(ensureProfile·agreeTerms·setFirstLevel·switchLanguage·lowerLevel·startTrial·getReadiness). 클라이언트 3종에 SupabaseClient<Database>, src/types/database.ts 생성. test:db: dbGlobalSetup이 `npx supabase status -o env`의 API_URL·PUBLISHABLE_KEY·SECRET_KEY를 process.env(NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL·NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY·SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY)에 넣음, src/test/db.ts: createTestUser·createReadyUser(language, level)·deleteTestUser(id)·deleteTestUsers(afterEach용)·anonClient·signedInClient(user). 권한 거부는 code 42501 + 메시지 'permission denied for table|function X'로 확인. 테스트 42개(rpc·account·security) 통과

steps.name: db-chat
steps.summary: supabase/migrations/20261006083621_chat.sql: helper kst_today_start()·current_plan(p_user_id)→'free'|'pro'·chat_turn_limit(p_user_id)(20/150)·chat_failure_limit_reached(p_user_id)(오늘 chat_failed ≥10)·record_limit_reached(p_user_id, p_feature)(props feature·plan·trial_eligible, step 2 words도 사용)·record_chat_failed(p_user_id, p_operation_token, p_kind, p_reason)·end_chat_with_fallback(p_user_id, p_session_id)→대체 피드백·recover_expired_operations(p_user_id)(active 만료 pending 삭제/ending 만료 fallback, 작업당 chat_failed reason 'expired' 1개), RPC create_chat_session(p_user_id, p_language, p_level, p_scenario_id)→session_id·begin_chat_turn(p_user_id, p_session_id, p_user_text)→token·turn_no·language·level·scenario_id·history·finish_chat_turn(p_user_id, p_session_id, p_token, p_reply, p_reply_ko, p_correction jsonb)→turns_left(마지막 확정이 한도를 채우면 limit_reached)·fail_chat_turn(p_user_id, p_session_id, p_token, p_reason)·begin_end(p_user_id, p_session_id)→state ended|ending|reserved·finish_end(…, p_token, p_feedback jsonb)·fail_end(…, p_token, p_reason) (모두 profiles 잠금 → 복구 → 세션 id+user_id FOR UPDATE, INVOKER, service_role만 EXECUTE). src/server/db/chat.ts(server-only) export 타입 ChatSessionInfo·EndResult·BeginEndResult, 함수와 에러 코드: createChatSession(userId, {language, level, scenarioId})→{sessionId} [CONSENT_REQUIRED, ONBOARDING_REQUIRED, CONFLICT(레벨 불일치)]; beginChatTurn(userId, sessionId, userText)→{token, turnNo, session, history} [NOT_FOUND, CONSENT_REQUIRED, ONBOARDING_REQUIRED, CONFLICT(종료 중·끝남·처리 중 턴), AI_FAILURE_LIMIT, SESSION_FULL, LIMIT_REACHED]; finishChatTurn(userId, sessionId, token, TurnReply)→{turnsLeft} [NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT(토큰 불일치·만료)]; failChatTurn(userId, sessionId, token, AiFailureReason)→null [NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT]; beginEnd(userId, sessionId)→BeginEndResult(0턴 skipped, 실패 10회면 chat_failed 없이 fallback) [NOT_FOUND, CONSENT_REQUIRED, ONBOARDING_REQUIRED, CONFLICT(턴 처리 중)]; finishEnd(userId, sessionId, token, Feedback)→EndResult(ready) [NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT]; failEnd(userId, sessionId, token, AiFailureReason)→EndResult(fallback) [NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT]. src/types/database.ts 재생성. 테스트: chat.test.ts 26개(정상 흐름·동시 예약·한도·Pro·어제·SESSION_FULL·AI_FAILURE_LIMIT·종료·경합·만료 복구·남의 세션) + security.test.ts 대화 함수 15개 anon/authenticated 거부, test:db 69개 통과
